prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image, then copy the resulting image file to incoming/alcove-summer.png in this repo. Use a 16:9 landscape size at the highest quality. Do not edit any other files. When done, print the saved path and the pixel dimensions.
The attached image (incoming/alcove-autumn.png) is the reference: pass it to the image generation tool as the input image to edit, so the camera, framing and materials stay identical.

Image prompt:
Using the reference image, keep the camera position, framing, plaster wall, wooden floor board, pine post, bronze basin and stone exactly the same. Change only the season to high summer: remove the maple leaves; the moss is deep, lush green, freshly misted with fine water droplets; the bronze basin is filled with still, clear water around the stone, faintly reflecting the wall. Soft, humid daylight from the left. Muted, natural colours, realistic photograph. No text, no people, no other objects. 16:9.
